summary: Held through an initial dip to -78pts (66% giveback) since early legs of this kind often recover, and price did bounce back to -47pts by t=7m with both HA and PROPP firing with the short thesis. But at t=8m that recovery fully round-tripped (92% giveback of the bounce leg) and price punched to a fresh extreme of -80.25, worse than any prior frame, with both HA and PROPP flipping back against the position simultaneously - a failed-bounce/lower-low pattern that signaled the thesis was actually broken, not just dipping, so I bailed. Next time watch for a bounce that fails to hold and re-tests/exceeds the prior extreme with confirming against-fires on two independent signal families at once - that combination is a stronger wrong-direction tell than depth of drawdown alone.
